description: SS 245A participation exemption: gross income $2,000,000 includes $500,000 of foreign-source dividends from a specified 10%-owned foreign corporation (attested: non-hybrid, 365-day holding). 100% DRD, never SS 246(b)-limited -> TI = 2,000,000 - 800,000 - 500,000 = 700,000 -> 21% = $147,000.00.
